items.message: Two trends fit this persona right now. I skipped two that are either overplayed or not her kind of content.

templates.title: Emergency fit, pero Pinoy
templates.trend: "the emergency fashion trend but im actually filipino" has 22M views on Shorts. The format: a fashion emergency solved with things every Filipino home has.

beats.shot: Panicked face to camera, phone showing the time.
Fast cuts grabbing very Filipino fixes: tabo, safety pin, tita's scarf, Hello Kitty clip.
Hard cut on the beat to the finished outfit, walking toward the camera.
Close-up of the most absurd item, deadpan.

templates.caption: pinoy fashion emergency kit, pls tell me I'm not the only one 😭
templates.audio: The fast transition sound used by the original trend
templates.fit: Budget fashion is exactly this persona’s lane. Swap the original’s items for things from the creator’s own room and the 200-peso angle the persona is built on.

templates.title: My PBB nomination, if I were in the house
templates.trend: "pbb collab 3.0" is up 500% on Google Trends PH (5K+ searches), and started 4 hours ago. Nomination tally videos already have 61K views.
templates.hook: POV: you're nominating your barkada sa PBB

beats.shot: Confession-room framing: sit centered, dim light, serious face.
beats.text: POV: you're nominating your barkada sa PBB

beats.shot: Name a friend and give a petty, specific reason.
Second friend, an even pettier reason. Lean into the camera.
Big Brother voice, off camera: "Salamat." Walk out.

templates.caption: sorry na agad sa barkada 😭 sino nomination niyo?
templates.audio: Original voice, plus the PBB confession-room hum underneath
templates.fit: Not fashion, but it’s a POV format the audience is watching right now. Rewritten as a petty barkada skit in the persona’s voice instead of a show recap.

skipped.reason: A dance trend, and this persona doesn’t do choreo. It’s also 7 months old and slowing down.
Crowded format where most videos stay under 2K views. Nobody is breaking out.
